text:
maria: FYI seeing a spike of 429s from the k8s API on prod-usa while flux/ sealed-secrets reconcile. A bunch of GPU-serving Deployments are stuck in CrashLoop because the sealed secret never decrypted/mounted.

aj: ugh, any idea what triggered it? secret rotation?

maria: looks like a scheduled key rotation from vault triggered re-seal updates across ~120 namespaces. flux tried to reconcile all of them at once -> syncer started throttling.

sam: is this flux v1 syncer or the new multi-tenant controller?

maria: fluxcd v2, default sync interval. syncer pods hit API rate limits, then backoff. sealed-secrets-controller also got bursts of update requests.

kevin: deploy-bot reported ~40 GPU pods in Pending/CrashLoop for the last 20m. Cost impact: wasted reserved nodes and failed inference jobs. not great.

linda: can we short-circuit rollout to avoid restarting GPU processes until secrets available? e.g., hold canaries or use canary flag in rollout?

aj: short-term options: 1) scale flux syncer to 3 replicas and bump apiQPS/ burst if safe, 2) pause bulk secret commits in gitops, 3) patch sealed-secrets-controller to batch updates slower.

maria: trying 1) now: kubectl -n flux-system scale deployment flux-controller --replicas=3 && patch --patch '{"spec":{"qps":50,"burst":100}}' to the controller-manager.

fluxcd-bot: flux sync request queued for 120 resources. current rate limit 10 req/s.

kevin: while you do that, can we rehydrate the most critical secrets via a direct vault->k8s apply for inference-prod namespaces so GPU pods can start?

sam: I'll run a targeted vault sync for gpu-serving-* namespaces and mark others as deferred. command: 
```
vault read -format=json secret/data/inference/prod | jq -r '.data.data' | kubectl apply -f - -n inference-prod
```

linda: for longer term: we should 1) add a CI guard preventing mass SOPS re-encrypts across >20 namespaces in single PR, 2) move frequent-rotate secrets to external-secrets or use per-app KMS so flux doesn't touch them journaled across all namespaces, 3) introduce jittered rollouts in our gitops operator.

aj: agree on CI guard. also we should add prometheus alerts for flux API throttling and sealed-secrets reconcile_error_rate so we catch this early.

maria: quick status: scaled flux-controller, applied qps patch, and sam started targeted vault sync. deploy-bot shows ~12 pods recovered so far. still seeing throttling but improving.

kevin: can someone open an eng-infra ticket to document runbook: secret-rotation -> expected reconcile load, throttling thresholds, emergency vault-direct sync steps, and cost-owner notification for GPU waste? I'll loop in finance for transient costs.

aj: I'll create the runbook and a PR for the CI guard. ping me if you want the PR reviewed quickly.

maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: (1) sam to finish targeted sync (2) aj to add CI guard + alerting (3) kevin to create cost incident and postmortem if needed. I'll monitor for the next 2 hours. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident created: INFRA-3919 "Secret-sync backpressure causing GPU rollout failures" assigned to eng-infra.

maria: closing the loop — pods are mostly healthy, dropping to normal API usage. we'll keep the runbook and CI guard as action items.
